title: Rediscovering Grete Stern and Horacio Coppola
summary_en: Horacio Coppola and Grete Stern are pivotal figures in the art of 20th century Argentina. Beginning Sept. 9, the WashU Kemper Art Museum will explore their legacy as part of “Buenos Aires Modern, 1935–1950,” the first U.S. exhibition to examine how local, exile and immigrant artists adopted and transformed the aesthetics of international modernism.
title_cn: Rediscovering Grete Stern and Horacio Coppola

title: ‘Buy now, pay later’ may reshape retail prices, inventory, WashU research finds
summary_en: New research from WashU Olin Business finds popular installment payment plans are changing not only how consumers pay, but also the prices they face and the way retailers manage their businesses.
